meta.countingConventions: See the header of tools/re-bpmn-js/enumerate.mjs and SPEC_RE_BPMN_JS_PARITY.md section 3. Counts are distinct keys per family under those conventions.
sourceGaps: color package (3 types per the A-prime spec) has no JSON descriptor in this checkout: bpmn-moddle/lib/simple.js imports bpmn-in-color-moddle, whose files are absent (no node_modules, no dist). Not counted in moddle-type; recorded here as missing source.
Dynamic EventBus names ending in a dot (commandStack., drag., keyboard.) are single entries flagged dynamicPrefix; concrete suffixed names are runtime-built and not enumerable statically.

Three bpmn-js-examples directories (custom-bower-bundle, simple-bower, simple-commonjs) are upstream tombstones whose README only records their removal as of bpmn-js 0.27.0; they carry no behaviour and are excluded from the example family.
meta.licenceNote: Behavioural reimplementation only (clean room). No third-party code is copied; see the spec licence section.
